paragraph: What am I **supposed** to do now? We're **supposed** to meet at my hotel. You are not **supposed** to smoke here.
english: to take for granted
arabicDesc: مثال: چکار قراره بکنم من الان؟

paragraph: Maybe you should lose some extra **weight**. You could say that both of those balls are the same **weight**. I've lost a little **weight**.
english: the downwards force an object experiences due to gravity
arabicDesc: مثال: أظنّ أنّه من الأفضل أن تفقد بعض الوزن.

paragraph: The current **supply** isn't enough to meet the demand. The store can **supply** us with anything we need. **Supply** me with this information as soon as possible.
english: act of supplying
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: توريد، إمداد

paragraph: Haven't I told you it's dangerous to **speed** in this area? Didn't I tell you it's dangerous to **speed** on the road? There is more to life than increasing its **speed**.
english: the state of moving quickly or the capacity for rapid motion
arabicDesc: مثال: ألم أخبرك أنّه من الخطر أن تسرع في هذه المنطقة؟

paragraph: Most people write about their **daily** life. I take two newspapers **daily**. You add so much meaning to my **daily** life.
english: that occurs every day
arabicDesc: مثال: معظم الناس يكتبون عن حياتهم اليومية.

paragraph: The region is small, but has a large **population**. The city has a **population** of about four million. The **population** has doubled in the last five years.
english: all people living within a political or geographical boundary

other.meaning: number of residents in a given area

paragraph: Don't let him **associate** with this kind of people. Don't **associate** yourself with people that give up easily. I can't believe you **associate** with criminals like them.
english: to connect one thing with another in your mind; a person you work with

paragraph: **December** is the final month of the year. He will be back within a week, that is, **December** 10. I made a lot of money in **December**.
english: the twelfth month of the year

paragraph: I'm finding it **difficult** deciding on which one to buy. It's going to be **difficult** for us to do that. I find it **difficult** to express my meaning in words.
english: hard, not easy
arabicDesc: مثال: يصعب علي أن أقرر أيها سأشتري.

paragraph: I didn't think you were interested in **modern** art. The new school is of simple and **modern** construction. My mother doesn't know how to cook **modern** food.
english: pertaining to the current time and style
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: عصري، معاصر

paragraph: I just wanted to be **popular**. This teacher is said to be **popular** with children. Why do you think football isn't **popular** in America?
english: of or pertaining to the common people
arabicDesc: مثال: أردت الشهرة فقط.

paragraph: I have a friend **whose** father is a famous actor. A human is one in **whose** heart is feeling. In **whose** interest are you acting, may I ask?
english: of whom (relative)
arabicDesc: مثال: لي صديق أباه ممثل مشهور.

paragraph: I have been busy **writing** a short story. She's **writing** an article for the school newspaper. Have you finished **writing** the letter yet?
english: written letters or symbols
arabicDesc: مثال: كنت مشغولاً بكتابة قصة قصيرة.

paragraph: What are those **spots** on your skin? I was in a dark **spot** at the time. Bill, have you taken **Spot** for a walk yet?
english: a round or irregular patch of a different color
arabicDesc: مثال: ما هذه البقع على بشرتك؟

paragraph: If I knew the **truth**, I would tell you. Why don't you want to tell us the **truth**? I don't want him to know the **truth**.
english: true facts
arabicDesc: مثال: إذا عرفت الحقيقة سأخبرك.

paragraph: She has a **rose** in her hand. He edged his chair back and **rose**. The sun **rises** in the east.
english: to move, or appear to move, physically upwards relative to the ground
arabicDesc: مثال: إنها تمسك وردة في يدها.

paragraph: You need not have such **fear**. Where is this **fear** coming from? You have nothing to **fear**.
english: a strong, unpleasant emotion or feeling caused by actual or perceived danger or threat
arabicDesc: مثال: عليك عدم الخوف.

other.meaning: To be afraid of (something or someone) (verb)

paragraph: We need to **prepare** for the worst. You didn't **prepare** for the future. You have to be **prepared** for anything.
english: to make ready for a specific future purpose
arabicDesc: مثال: علينا أن نستعد للأسوء.

paragraph: Don't forget to **count** how many people attend. That child is only four, but he can already **count** to 100. She can **count** from one to ten.
english: to enumerate or determine number
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تنس أن تعدّ الحاضرين.

other.meaning: A nobleman holding a rank intermediate between dukes and barons (noun)

paragraph: **Welcome** back. We missed you! He didn't **welcome** the guests. You're **welcome** to stay as long as you want.
english: greeting given upon someone's arrival
arabicDesc: مثال: أهلاً بعودتك. لقد اشتقنا إليك!

other.meaning: The act of greeting someone’s arrival, especially by saying "Welcome!" (noun)
To affirm or greet the arrival of someone, especially by saying "Welcome!" (verb)

paragraph: How on **earth** could such a mistake have happened? People used to think that the **earth** was flat. We know that the Sun is bigger than the **Earth**.
english: soil
arabicDesc: مثال: كيف يُعقل بأن يحدث مثل هذا الخطأ؟

other.meaning: world of our current life, as opposed to afterlife
The third planet of the Solar System (noun)

paragraph: He turned down my **application**. It is a good **application** to start doing sport. You still have to fill in this **application** form.
english: the act of physically applying or laying on
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد رفض طلبي.

other.meaning: the act of physically applying or laying on

paragraph: I can't be **content** with that. I want more. It helped me become much more **content** with myself. She says that she is **content** with her life.
english: the amount of material contained
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: كمية

other.meaning: To give contentment or satisfaction to (verb)

paragraph: To tell the truth, she is my **sister**. I like dogs, but my **sister** likes cats. She threw her **sister** out of her apartment.
english: woman or girl having the same parents
arabicDesc: مثال: هي، في الحقيقة، أختي.

paragraph: He was a good **worker**, say what you will. They do not want the **worker** to be free. There was an attack on a **worker** last night.
english: person who performs labor
arabicDesc: مثال: هو كان عاملاً جيداً, قُل ما شئت.

paragraph: You're so funny, you make me **laugh**. What makes you **laugh** like that? Promise me you won't **laugh**.
english: show mirth by peculiar movement of the muscles of the face and emission of sounds
arabicDesc: مثال: أنت مضحك للغاية, جعلتني أضحك.

paragraph: Does he have something in common with this **movement**? He is being carried away by a student **movement**. The address was in favor of their social **movement**.
english: physical motion

paragraph: Do you mind if I open the **window**? It was warm, so I opened the **window**. It's very cold. Should I shut the **window**?
english: opening for light and air
arabicDesc: مثال: ألا تمانع أن أفتح النافذة؟

paragraph: There is a **huge** fire up there. China is a **huge** global player. What is that **huge** building?
english: very large
arabicDesc: مثال: يوجد حريق هائل هناك.

paragraph: No one has ever lied on the **Internet**. Our company makes use of the **Internet**. I downloaded this book from the **Internet**.
english: specific internet consisting of the global network of computers
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يَكْذِبْ أَحَدٌ قَطُّ على الإنترنت.

paragraph: I am looking for a job, **sir**. I'm sorry, **sir**. You were saying? Can I help you, **sir**?
english: address to any male, especially if his name or proper address is unknown
arabicDesc: مثال: أبحث عن عمل يا سيدي.

paragraph: I want to be a **doctor** in the future. If her temperature goes up, send for the **doctor**. The **doctor** asked me to take off my shirt.
english: a person trained to treat sick people
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد أن أكون طبيباً في المستقبل.

paragraph: I have a **pain** in my foot. He experienced a **pain** in his leg. I have a burning **pain** here.
english: ache or bodily suffering
arabicDesc: مثال: لدي ألم في قدمي.

paragraph: Do you know how to use a **computer**? The **computer** is placed to the left of the women. They spent the night fixing the **computer**.
english: an electronic machine that stores and processes information
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تعرف كيف تستعمل الحاسوب؟

paragraph: They said that they felt no **pressure** to win. I can't put any **pressure** on this foot yet. It's hard for me to handle so much **pressure**.
english: a pressing

paragraph: **Fill** in your name and address here. Please **fill** up the bottle with water. Please **fill** out this form first.
english: add contents to, so it is full
arabicDesc: مثال: أكتب اسمك و عنوانك هنا.

paragraph: Pick up the right **option**. I have no other **option**. Peace was never an **option**.
english: something you can choose
arabicDesc: مثال: اختر الخيار الصحيح.

paragraph: He used to come here to take the **treatment**. These are patients who have had individual **treatment** paths. You should stay in the hospital for **treatment**.
english: medical care for an illness or injury
arabicDesc: مثال: كان يأتي إلى هنا كي يتلقّ العلاج.

paragraph: He lost his reason when he saw his house **burn** down. Why did she **burn** those letters? Where did you **burn** them?
english: physical injury
arabicDesc: مثال: فقد رباطة جأشه عند رؤيته لبيته و هو يحترق.

other.meaning: To be consumed by fire or in flames (verb)

paragraph: It is impossible to **master** English in a year or so. He tried to **master** French. You're like a dog that wants to please the **master** that abuses it.
english: someone who has control over something or someone
arabicDesc: مثال: من المستحيل إتقان اللغة الإنجليزية خلال عامٍ واحد أو ما يقارب ذلك.

paragraph: He kept a **seat** for me. Sit in the back **seat**. Go back to your **seat**.
english: place in which to sit
arabicDesc: مثال: حجز مقعداً لي.

paragraph: I don't know exactly when he will **arrive**. What time did you **arrive** there? We'll **arrive** there within an hour.
english: to reach
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أعلم متى سيصل بالضبط.

paragraph: Don't forget to **feed** the dog. Does the man **feed** the cat? One has to pay a **fee** to transfer money.
english: an amount charged in return for permission to do something
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تنس تقديم الأكل للكلب.

paragraph: I think it is important that we keep our **promise**. Just **promise** me you won't do this again. I **promise** you, we as a people will get there.
english: an oath or affirmation
arabicDesc: مثال: أعتقد أنه من المهم أن نفي بوعدنا.

other.meaning: To commit to (some action or outcome), or to assure (a person) of such commitment (verb)

paragraph: You may be right, but I am against your **opinion**. I would like to hear your **opinion**. I don't remember asking for your **opinion**.
english: thought a person has formed about a topic
arabicDesc: مثال: ربما تكون مُحقًّا لكنني أعارض رأيك.

paragraph: What is this **fish** called in English? I can teach you how to **fish**. Do you think **fish** can hear?
english: vertebrate animal
arabicDesc: مثال: ما اسم تلك السمكة بالإنجليزية؟

other.meaning: To hunt fish or other aquatic animals in a body of water, or to collect coral or pearls from the bottom of the sea (verb)

paragraph: The **conference** ended two hours ago. The press **conference** got so crowded. The **conference** ended at five.
english: a meeting of people
arabicDesc: مثال: المؤتمر إنتهى قبل ساعتين.

paragraph: My father is the vice president of the **association**. My **association** with him did not last long. For me, that word doesn't have a very good **association**.
english: group of persons associated for a common purpose

paragraph: Give the book back to the **owner**. She is the **owner** of a very big house. Has the dog been taken home by its **owner**?
english: one who owns
arabicDesc: مثال: أعد الكتاب إلى صاحبه.

paragraph: Are you sure you want to block this **user**? You will be provided with your own **user** account. This **user** hasn't been online for two years.
english: one who uses or makes use of something, a consumer or client or an express or implied licensee (free user) or a trespasser
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مستخدمة

other.meaning: one who uses something, a consumer

paragraph: Fill out the form **below**. To see this point, look at the table **below**. Wait for me **below**. I'll be there in a minute.
english: lower in spatial position than
arabicDesc: مثال: املأ الطلب أدناه.

paragraph: The radio was **missing** from the boat. What is **missing** in this car? One of my bags is **missing**.
english: not able to be located
arabicDesc: مثال: كان جهاز الرّاديو غير موجود على متن السّفينة.

paragraph: It's about a **ten**-minute drive from here. He returned home for the first time in **ten** years. What would you do if you were **ten** years younger?
english: the cardinal number occurring after 9 and before 11
arabicDesc: مثال: تبعد مسافة عشر دقائق بالسيارة عن هنا.

paragraph: Be sure of your **target** and what's behind it. Every time I practice shooting, I miss the **target**. How do you practice speaking in your **target** languages?
english: a butt or mark to shoot at, as for practice, or to test the accuracy of a firearm, or the force of a projectile
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نيشان

other.meaning: To aim something, especially a weapon, at (a target) (verb)

paragraph: What is the matter of **surprise** in it? He looked at me in **surprise**. I have a **surprise** for you.
english: cause (someone) to feel surprise
arabicDesc: مثال: ما العجب في ذلك؟

paragraph: Mr **Brown** is our English teacher. She was wearing dark **brown** shoes. He had dark **brown** hair.
english: transliterations of the English name "Brown"
arabicDesc: مثال: السيد براون هو معلمنا في الإنجليزية.

paragraph: She has some **funny** ideas about how to run a company. I knew that something **funny** might happen. We saw a **funny** movie last Sunday.
english: amusing; comical
arabicDesc: مثال: لديها أفكار مضحكة حول كيفية إدارة شركة.

paragraph: What drink **mix** are you adding to the water? We **mix** with the good, not with the bad. **Mix** in some low-impact exercises for joint health.
english: stir two or more substances together
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مزج

paragraph: My **partner** was there when our child was born. We can't close the deal until my **partner** arrives. My **partner** is having a relationship outside our marriage.
english: either of a pair of people or things that belong together
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: شريكة، رفيق، رفيقة

paragraph: I don't know how to **handle** children. How do you two **handle** conflict? I can't **handle** his comments.
english: the part of an object which is (designed to be) held in the hand when used or moved
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أعرف كيف أتعامل مع الأطفال.

paragraph: Because I had a **cold**, I stayed at home. It isn't as **cold** here as I expected. I don't mind if it's a little **cold**.
english: having a low temperature
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد بقيت في المنزل لأنني كنت مصاباً بالزكام .

paragraph: Flying is the quickest **method** of travelling. This is definitely the best **method**. Here is a **method** of fighting down your fear.
english: process by which a task is completed
arabicDesc: مثال: الطيران أسرع وسيلة سفر.

paragraph: Hard **labor** was beginning to tell on his health. I walked there as if going to forced **labor**. The machine will save you much time and **labor**.
english: hard work, especially physical work; also workers as a group

paragraph: The majority of the **committee** were against the plan. The **committee** meets twice a month. The **committee** consists of four members.
english: group of persons convened for the accomplishment of some specific purpose
arabicDesc: مثال: أغلبية اللجنة كانت معارضةً للخطة.

paragraph: I'll feed it to you so ... here, open **wide**. They were standing still with their eyes **wide** open. The **wide** river was next to a big city.
english: having a large physical extent from side to side

paragraph: Are you looking for something **specific**? I'm going to need you to be more **specific**. I have never been to that **specific** camping spot.
english: exact and particular
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تبحث عن شيء معين

paragraph: Could you tell me how to use this washing **machine**? Let's take a look at this **machine**. Is there a cash **machine** near here?
english: mechanical or electrical device
arabicDesc: مثال: أيمكنك أن تعلّمني كيف أستخدم الغسّالة؟

paragraph: The **stock** market has dropped today. The **stock** market is very active. The **stock** prices are on the low side today.
english: a store or supply
arabicDesc: مثال: انخفضت الأسعار في سوق الأسهم اليوم.

other.meaning: supply of anything ready for use

paragraph: I am going to **Europe** next week. I went to **Europe** once. France is in Western **Europe**.
english: a continent located west of Asia (separated by the Urals), north of Africa and east of the Atlantic Ocean
arabicDesc: مثال: سأذهب إلى أوروبا الاسبوع المقبل.

paragraph: There are a lot of rivers in **India**. It looks like you are from **India**. I am not from **India**.
english: the country
arabicDesc: مثال: في الهند أنهار كثيرة.

paragraph: The office for disease control reported a 10 **percent** spread. I agree one hundred **percent**. More than 90 **percent** of visits to a web page are from search engines.
english: a part or other object per hundred
arabicDesc: مثال: أفاد مكتب مكافحة الأمراض انتشار نسبة 10 في المئة.

paragraph: Is it a **recent** picture? **Recent** evidence suggests that this is not the case. The children have grown a lot in **recent** months.
english: having happened a short while ago
arabicDesc: مثال: هل هذه صورة حديثة؟

paragraph: I just want a **straight** answer. Nothing more. Guide us to the **straight** way. Show us the **straight** path.
english: not crooked or bent
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد فقط إجابة صريحة، لا أكثر.

other.meaning: Of a direction relative to the subject, precisely (adverb)

paragraph: I am a street **artist**. She is a street **artist**. He is a famous **artist**.
english: person who creates art
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا فنان شوارع.

other.meaning: person who creates art as an occupation

paragraph: My mother made me a new **dress**. Where is the rest of this **dress**? Where have I seen that **dress** before?
english: apparel or clothing, especially when appropriate for a particular occasion, profession, etc
arabicDesc: مثال: صنعت لي أمي فستانًا جديدًا.

paragraph: Remember to **update** the operating system for improved performance. I feel like it's gotten faster after the **update**. She's going to try rolling back an **update**.
english: action of making something up to date

paragraph: He went on trial charged with **murdering** her wife. The house was the place of several **murders**. There were a lot of **murders** last year.
english: an act of killing a person unlawfully, especially with predetermination

other.meaning: To illegally kill (a person or persons) with intent, especially with predetermination (verb)

paragraph: This afternoon we will have an **interview**. I was **interviewed** for a job. He wasn't in a position to give any **interview**.
english: conversation with journalist etc.
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا المساء سَنَقومُ بِمُقابلةٍ

paragraph: It's not the time but the will that you **lack**. He is **lacking** in experience. **Lack** of respect is something I can't live with.
english: deficiency, need
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس الوقتُ ما ينقصك وإنما الإرادةُ.

paragraph: He already knows enough to **launch** a large-scale project. They decided to **launch** a major attack. He is planning to **launch** his business.
english: to throw (a projectile such as a lance, dart or ball)
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: قذف

paragraph: I need to **refer** to my notes at this point. Don't **refer** to this matter again, please. I can **refer** you to a good book on this subject.
english: to direct the attention of (someone toward something)

paragraph: I felt the **wind** blowing on my face. The wild **wind** was blowing. The **wind** shook the windows.
english: movement of air
arabicDesc: مثال: شعرت بالريح يهبّ على وجهي.

other.meaning: To turn coils (of a cord or something similar) around something (verb)

paragraph: This is the place where the **battle** took place. It was not one **battle**, but many. Knowing is half the **battle**.
english: general action, fight, or encounter; a combat
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا مكان المعركة.

paragraph: Why did they fire you from the **agency**? Do you want to work for my **agency**? The **agency** is the size of a city.
english: office of an agent, or relation between a principal and his agent

other.meaning: capacity of acting or of exerting power

paragraph: Is this in fact going to **affect** their relationships? I've been concerned that it might **affect** our relationship. Those are material concerns, which no longer **affect** me.
english: to influence or alter

paragraph: They haven't named their **band** yet. They said that they want to join our **band**. I liked that **band** better before they became popular.
english: group of musicians
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يسموا فرقتهم بعد.

paragraph: The police used tear **gas** against the protesting students. My car burns a lot of **gas**. He ran back to the **gas** station.
english: (uncountable, chemistry) state of matter
arabicDesc: مثال: استعملت الشرطة الغاز المسيل للدموع ضد الطلبة المحتجين.

paragraph: She is a new **addition** to the teaching staff. The set of real numbers is closed under **addition**. I want to study German in **addition** to English.
english: the act of adding anything

paragraph: Do you think he made that mistake on **purpose**? What is the **purpose** of your visit? What's your **purpose** in visiting this country?
english: end for which something is done, is made or exists
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تظنه أخطأ عمدًا؟

paragraph: I'm not sure if I can **host** that day. A **host** of friends came to see me off. What kind of party do you want to **host**?
english: one which receives or entertains a guest, socially, commercially, or officially

other.meaning: person or organisation responsible for running an event

paragraph: Stopping population **growth** is like stopping a speeding train. Women, then, are only children of a larger **growth**. Population **growth** has given rise to serious social problems.
english: an increase in size, number, value, or strength
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نمو

paragraph: I don't doubt your word, I doubt your **ability**. I don't doubt his **ability** to do it. And everyone has the **ability** to contribute.
english: quality or state of being able
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أشكّ في ما تقوله، و إنّما أشكّ في قدراتك.

paragraph: He sold the most beautiful pieces in his **collection**. I have 59 trading cards left to finish the **collection**. How many games do you have in your **collection**?
english: set of items
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: جمع

paragraph: Do they have the legal **authority** to do that? I'm not used to having people question my **authority**. They have a complete lack of respect for **authority**.
english: power or right to make or enforce rules, give orders, or impose obligation

paragraph: I will have been studying English for five years next **February**. He has not written to us since last **February**. If I'll make it, we'll see again in **February**!
english: the second month of the year
arabicDesc: مثال: سأكون قد درست الإنجليزية لخمس سنوات مع حلول فبراير المقبل.

paragraph: I'm a man and I'm **married** to a woman. His life has completely changed when he **married** her. We got **married** because we love each other.
english: in a state of marriage; having a wife or a husband
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا رجل و إني متزوج مع امرأة.

other.meaning: in a state of marriage; having a husband

paragraph: **Shall** we go to my place or yours? What **shall** I do with her letter? One day we **shall** be married.
english: used for the future with I and we, or in offers and rules
arabicDesc: مثال: هل نذهب عندى أم عندك ؟

paragraph: Would you like to go out with me **tonight**? I just don't feel like going out **tonight**. What are you going to do **tonight**?
english: during today's nighttime
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تريدين الخروج معي الليلة؟

other.meaning: The nighttime of the current day or date (noun)

paragraph: The **structure** of the text has value in analysis. You have to organize the **structure** of the game. This is the most massive **structure** I've ever seen.
english: a cohesive whole built up of distinct parts

paragraph: My sister is **quick**-thinking. The things we want, we are **quick** to believe. Can I have a **quick** word with you guys?
english: moving with speed
arabicDesc: مثال: أختي سريعة التفكير.
